subject: science
passage: Biologists have long debated why zebras have stripes. One idea is that the stripes discourage biting flies such as horseflies, which spread disease among grazing animals. To test this idea, researchers observed horseflies around horses wearing either plain cloth coats or black-and-white striped ones. Flies approached both groups of horses at similar rates, but they landed far less often on the striped coats, frequently flying past or bumping into them. Because the animals beneath the coats were all horses, these results suggest that ______
stem: Which choice most logically completes the text?

choices.A: striped coats keep horses cooler than plain coats do.
choices.B: horseflies cannot detect striped animals from a distance.
choices.C: a striped pattern itself can make it harder for flies to land.
choices.D: stripes protect animals from every insect that spreads disease.

explanation.why: The only difference between the two groups was the pattern of the coat; the animals underneath were all horses. Since flies approached both groups equally but landed less on the striped coats, the stripes themselves seem to interfere with landing.
explanation.A: Incorrect. The text says nothing about temperature; the study measured fly behavior.
explanation.B: Incorrect. Flies approached both groups at similar rates, so they did detect the striped horses; the difference came only at landing.
explanation.C: Correct. With the same animal under every coat, the pattern is the factor that reduced landings.
explanation.D: Incorrect. The study observed only horseflies, so it cannot support a claim about every disease-carrying insect.
